messages.subject: dynamically set height in renderPlot?
parts:
Hi,

What is the best way to set the height argument of renderPlot based on the size of the data it's trying to plot?

Here is some pseudo code:

getData = reactive({
#fetch data
})

plotFunc = function() { 
myData = getData()
plot(myData)
})

plotHeight = reactive({
myData = getData()
if (length(myData) < 18) 
return(400)
if (length(myData) >= 18) 
return(800) 
})

output$plot  = renderPlot(plotFunc(),height=plotHeight,units="px")


This doesn't work as its nesting a reactive function plotHeight within another renderPlot.  I want to keep plotFunc as it's own function so that i can call upon it elsewhere.  I'm sure there is a simple answer, i'm just going code blind.

Thanks for your help.
